summary: Iteration 53: Admin Page RBAC Testing. Fixed route protection bug (exec_cadre was blocked from /admin). All 14 backend tests pass (100%). Frontend verification confirms: Commander sees all 3 tabs + all action buttons, Exec Cadre sees only All Users tab with Role/Unit dropdowns but no Permissions/Delete/Reset Password buttons. User grouping by Staff/Cadre/Parent with alphabetical sorting working correctly.

critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: App.js route for /admin was missing 'dcp' and 'exec_cadre' roles - now includes all admin-capable roles
Backend RBAC correctly implemented: exec_cadre can GET /api/users and PUT /api/users/{id}/role but NOT access pending users, delete users, or update permissions
Frontend RBAC correctly implemented: isFullAdmin check on line 39 restricts tabs and action buttons to dcp/commander/executive_staff only
User grouping correctly categorizes users into STAFF/CADRE/PARENT groups with alphabetical sorting within each group
Receipt OCR endpoint correctly uses EMERGENT_LLM_KEY environment variable (line 632 in budget.py)
Auto-assign endpoint works correctly for student flight assignment
